name: Chichibu Rabura
source:
A gyaru who works as an exorcist. Despite her profession, she does not believe in the existence of spirits. Her name is a pun on "chichi burabura" (乳ブラブラ, lit. "breasts dangling"). 

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Punch_Line_(anime)]Wikipedia[/url]]
